chat.temperatureTooltip: Controls randomness in responses. Higher values (1.0-2.0) make output more creative and random, while lower values (0.0-1.0) make it more focused and deterministic.

chat.topKTooltip: Only sample from the top K options for each subsequent token. Used to remove "long tail" low probability responses. Recommended for advanced use cases only. Leave empty to use model default.
chat.topPTooltip: Nucleus sampling. Controls diversity by limiting token selection to a cumulative probability. Lower values (e.g., 0.1) make output more focused, higher values (e.g., 0.9) allow more variety. It's recommended to set either temperature or topP, but not both.
